exposure: estimated fetal weight (EFW) ≥ 10th centile (appropriate for gestational age, AGA) at ≥35 weeks
persisting clinical suspicion of SGA on abdominal assessment
cohort: Pregnant women with a fetal growth ultrasound at ≥35 weeks reporting an EFW ≥ 10th centile who subsequently had an induction of labor or cesarean birth at ≥37 weeks due to ongoing clinical suspicion of SGA between 2012-2014
finding: Among women with a normal EFW at 35-37 weeks gestation, 68% of those who had a planned birth due to clinical suspicion of SGA delivered an SGA infant.
